_meta.description: Open and recently-resolved customer-reported tickets, with engineering annotations. Synced nightly from Zendesk via ops/scripts/sync-tickets.ts.

tickets.title: Receiving 2-3 copies of every webhook for the last 6 weeks
tickets.summary: Customer is processing every invoice.paid event 2-3 times. Started 2026-02-22 based on their logs.
tickets.engineering_notes: Looks like the same root cause as the 2026-04-08 incident. webhook-dispatcher claim query doesn't take a row lock. Open in PLAT-1102.

tickets.title: Enterprise discount not applied on March invoices
tickets.summary: Customer is on the Enterprise SKU with a 15% negotiated discount. Their March 2026 invoices reflect the full list price.
tickets.engineering_notes: Discount column was added in migration 0004 in February. We've checked DB and the subscriptions row has discount_pct=15.00. Looks like billing-engine never reads the column. Counted ~40 affected tenants.

tickets.title: Customer support sees invoices from other tenants when looking up by ID
tickets.summary: Our own CSM, helping atlas-fitness, pasted an invoice UUID and got back details for a different tenant.
tickets.engineering_notes: Hotfix landed in commit f4a2c1e (added tenant_id to WHERE). Post-incident audit of similar patterns was started but not completed. Suspect `/v1/customers/by-external-id` has the same issue.

tickets.title: Usage metering is intermittently low — invoices look 5-10% under
tickets.summary: Customer reconciles their internal API call logs against our daily_usage_rollups and sees ours running 5-10% low on some days, exact on others.
tickets.engineering_notes: Spot-checked Kafka topic and producer-side counts match. Suspicion is on the consumer — possibly silently swallowing validation failures or DB errors. Aggregator catches all exceptions at debug level.

tickets.title: Plan downgrade credit is off by 1 cent
tickets.summary: Customers occasionally see a credit that's 1 cent different from their own calculation. Most don't notice; the ones who do are usually fintech tenants.
tickets.engineering_notes: Tracked in incidents.md 2025-11. prorate() rounds each side independently. Property-based testing would catch this.

tickets.title: Customer lookup by external_id returns customers from other tenants
tickets.summary: Veriform's support tool pulls customers by external_id (their internal user UUIDs). On 2 occasions in the last week they got back rows for tenants that aren't theirs.
tickets.engineering_notes: Almost certainly the same class of bug as SUP-4855. Not yet investigated.
